profile.title: Software Developer | BSc.IT Student
profile.summary: I am a BSc.IT student at Asia Pacific University (Techspire College) and a software developer interested in building practical applications, websites, and interactive digital experiences. I work with JavaScript, React Native, Node.js, MySQL, Python, Java, and modern web technologies. I enjoy learning by building projects, solving problems, and turning ideas into working software. I am currently looking for an opportunity to begin my professional software development career and contribute to real-world projects.
